## Purpose and Entry Points
This is a documentation-first, 21-lesson Generative AI course, not a single deployable application. Learners enter through the course index and individual lesson READMEs; selected “Build” lessons provide independently runnable samples and notebooks.
- `README.md`
- `index.html`
- `docs/_sidebar.md`

## Course Content Architecture
Lessons are numbered, self-contained modules spanning foundations, prompts, application patterns, safety, lifecycle, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, and model families. Each lesson README is the canonical instructional boundary; build lessons attach language/provider-specific implementations.
- `00-course-setup/README.md`
- `06-text-generation-apps/README.md`
- `15-rag-and-vector-databases/README.md`

## Executable Sample Families
Runnable examples are deliberately duplicated by runtime and provider rather than composed into one shared app. Python scripts/notebooks, Node.js JavaScript, TypeScript CLI-style projects, and .NET interactive notebooks demonstrate equivalent GenAI workflows.
- `06-text-generation-apps/python/aoai-app.py`
- `06-text-generation-apps/typescript/recipe-app/src/main.ts`
- `07-building-chat-applications/js-githubmodels/app.js`

## Provider and Credential Boundary
Samples target Azure OpenAI, OpenAI API, and Microsoft Foundry/GitHub Models; some course material supports local/offline model execution through Foundry Local. Provider selection is reflected in filenames (`aoai`, `oai`, `githubmodels`) and per-sample environment templates. Credentials and endpoints are runtime inputs, not repository-managed infrastructure.
- `.env.copy`
- `08-building-search-applications/typescript/search-app/.env-sample`
- `11-integrating-with-function-calling/typescript/function-app/.env-sample`

## Search/RAG Data Pipeline
The search lesson contains the clearest multi-stage data flow: transcript download, lightweight enrichment, speaker/summary enrichment, embedding generation, then JSON embedding-index output consumed by search examples. This is an offline batch-preparation boundary separate from interactive query-time samples.
- `08-building-search-applications/scripts/transcript_download.py`
- `08-building-search-applications/scripts/transcript_enrich_embeddings.py`
- `08-building-search-applications/embedding_index_3m.json`

## Shared Python Guardrails
Reusable Python utilities centralize environment loading, API/provider setup, and input validation for samples, with tests establishing their expected behavior. These form the main shared-code boundary; most lesson applications otherwise remain isolated.
- `shared/python/api_utils.py`
- `shared/python/env_utils.py`
- `shared/python/input_validation.py`

## Localization, Site Delivery, and Governance
English source lessons are replicated under `translations/<locale>/`; translated image assets are separate. The static course site is rooted at `index.html`, with navigation under `docs/`. Development supports Python and Node ecosystems plus a dev container; GitHub Actions enforce quality, security, and repository maintenance rather than deploy an application.
- `translations/en/README.md`
- `translated_images/en/.co-op-translator.json`
- `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`
